pick.name: Sentry
pick.why: One tool across Next, Hono, Expo (@sentry/react-native), Electron (@sentry/electron) and Python
pick.free_limits: Developer: 5,000 errors, 5M spans, 50 replays, 1 uptime + 1 cron monitor, 1 user, 30-day lookback; Team $29/mo

best_free.name: Firebase Crashlytics
best_free.what: Mobile crash reporting (iOS/Android); no-cost on Spark and Blaze
best_free.install: npx expo install @react-native-firebase/app @react-native-firebase/crashlytics  (needs a development build and the config plugins; not Expo Go)

alts.name: PostHog error tracking
alts.why: If PostHog is already your analytics

alts.name: GlitchTip
alts.why: Self-hostable MIT alternative for web/server errors
alts.free_limits: Self-host; infra cost only; Sentry SDK compatibility not stated on page (unverified)
alts.maintained: 92 releases per repo page; dates not shown

candidates.name: Crashlytics
candidates.verdict: Wins for mobile-only at scale (no quota).

candidates.name: Expo Observability / EAS Observe
candidates.verdict: New native crash reporting (Oct 2026); Expo-only, pricing not checked.

decision: Sentry covers every surface of the one-stack with one SDK family. Pair with Crashlytics only if mobile crash volume exceeds Sentry's 5k free errors.

verify.note: Developer: 5k errors, 5M spans, 50 replays, 1 cron + 1 uptime monitor, 1 user, 30-day lookback; Team $29/mo ($26 annual).
